author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: भगवत्प्रतिपत्तौ साधनांतराण्याह ॥ निर्मानेति । मानमोहाभ्यां अहङ्कारमिथ्याज्ञानाभ्यां निर्गतास्ताभ्यां हीना इति यावत् । जितविषयसङ्गदोषाः । अध्यात्मनित्याः अध्यात्मज्ञाने भगवच्छ्रवणादौ निरताः, विशेषतो निवृत्तविषयतृष्णाः सुखदुःखसंज्ञैः द्वन्द्वैर्लाभालाभजयाजयादिरूपैर्विमुक्ताः, अमूढा रजस्तमस्स्वभावशून्याः अव्ययं तत्पदं भगवत्स्वरूपं गच्छंति ॥ १५.५॥
translation:
Those who are free from pride and delusion, who have subdued the evil of attachment (to the objects of sense), who are ever devoted to the knowledge of Paramatman, who have especially turned away from desires and have got themselves freed from the pairs of opposites known as pleasure and pain and have got over delusion-those go to that unchanging goal. (5)
V. Known as pleasure and pain: since they are the source of pleasure and pain. The pairs of opposites are profit and loss, victory and defeat, &c. Got over delusion: got over the influence of Rajas and Tamas. Unchanging goal: the glorious Lord Himself.
A. Of what description is that goal the attainment of which constitutes the highest purpose of man?
